scope: actor-only enforced sealed isolated simulation fixture; not a prediction model for unconstrained humans or hardware

mathematical_domain.interpolation: Each XYZ coordinate is monotone on every C1 smoothstep segment; extrema therefore occur at endpoints or intervening waypoint boundaries.
mathematical_domain.enumeration: Both full-horizon interval endpoints, start/end parking transitions, every interior waypoint and every loop seam are enclosed; loop endpoints agree in XYZ/yaw and parking occurs at complete periods.
mathematical_domain.complete_future_geometry: Every registered full shape uses all-yaw XY enclosure, original full-Z shape extents and outward-rounded closed AABBs.
mathematical_domain.future_padding: The actual same-step measured XYZ is included and both temporal interval ends extend by one original physics dt.
mathematical_domain.quaternion: Finite same-step native quaternion must have squared norm within 1e-6 of one; normalized tilt and actual measured XYZ deviations are independently enforced.
mathematical_domain.unscripted_actor: Retains original full XYZ speed/acceleration reachable sphere; no future script is inferred from current pose or heading.

physics_and_identity.actor_updater: Unique scene.py pre_step order=-1 callback writes world_builder.update_actors using original SimulationManager time relative to source_start_time plus actual step_dt.
physics_and_identity.config_identity: Scene bytes are checked against session scene SHA; actor registry includes original trajectory, future contract, shapes and start/end domain in its canonical SHA.
physics_and_identity.native_measurements: Same-step actual PhysX root pose/quaternion/velocity are retained; source stamp is anchor plus original simulation source, not receipt time.
physics_and_identity.native_ray_phase: Original capture BEGIN retained; native END must be one sealed physical step later within original dt/10 tolerance or bridge faults.
physics_and_identity.oracle_context: Original session/epoch/seed/context sequence/registry identity, complete actor set and original dynamic sequence fences remain.

stage_invariants.parent_to_world: Exact identity; no tolerance that could introduce an unsealed future displacement.
stage_invariants.ancestor_time_samples: No authored time samples on any ancestor attribute through World.
stage_invariants.counterexample: A parent rotation about the current actor position preserves its actual current XYZ but redirects the next local scripted translation. Reordered root rotateZ/translate also agrees at yaw zero and then changes future XYZ. Both revoke the geometry certificate.

hit_provenance_chain_review.native_identity: Only exact registered collision shape prim paths receive a sorted registry actor ordinal; parent, unknown child, static or missing paths remain zero.
hit_provenance_chain_review.wire: Optional 72-byte Isaac ray layout adds uint16 actor ordinal at byte64; original 3D endpoint/origin/time/source-index/ring fields are retained. Default/live original 64-byte layout remains strict.
hit_provenance_chain_review.projection: Structured wire bytes are copied before only original XYZ/origins are transformed; actor ordinal and original source metadata are preserved.
hit_provenance_chain_review.safety: 72-byte layout is opt-in isolated_mock only and actor ordinals are bounded by the sealed registry.
hit_provenance_chain_review.native_collision: Original complete dynamic oracle veto executes first. Native retained ray odds and stamps are not cleared or refreshed; only independently certified static FREE plus exact unpoisoned actor attribution and a strictly newer full closed-voxel-disjoint oracle may retire an actor contradiction.

verification.openusd: Actual pxr-backed source-stage tests ran; no Kit/ROS/native build/install invoked.
verification.fixture_correction: World time samples were already rejected by the earlier static-collider guard. The new regression explicitly checks the scripted-actor helper and preserves the original whole-stage rejection reason.
coverage: original USD positive and normal actor update notice caching
current-pose-preserving parent pivot changes future trajectory
full six-second continuous shape enclosure through turns/loop seams/parking

limitations: The source proof relies on this sealed fixture kinematic updater; it grants no constrained intent to a generic or freely moving person.
Offline USD/mathematical tests do not establish a formal navigation pass or physical acceptance.
Native full-scene actor-hit provenance, current model-domain ABI and actual navigation must be validated by the root-owned immutable candidate run.
